name: network-egress
description: Container/host can't reach external network. Layer-by-layer egress probe + iptables/route state.

commands.description: IP forwarding state (must be 1 for container egress)

commands.command: ip route show && echo '---' && ip -br link show

commands.description: Layer probe to public IP (no DNS dependency)
Layer probe to public DNS resolution
commands.command: getent hosts cloudflare.com 2>/dev/null || echo '(DNS resolution failed)'

commands.description: iptables NAT chains (look for MASQUERADE rule)
commands.command: sudo iptables -t nat -L POSTROUTING -n -v 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo '(iptables requires sudo or root)'
sudo iptables -L FORWARD -n -v 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo '(iptables requires sudo or root)'
sudo iptables -t nat -L DOCKER -n -v 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && sudo iptables -L DOCKER-USER -n -v 2>/dev/null || echo '(no docker iptables)'
systemctl is-active firewalld 2>/dev/null || echo 'firewalld inactive'; systemctl is-active ufw 2>/dev/null || echo 'ufw inactive'

commands.description: Conntrack table fill (UDP DNS replies dropped if full)
commands.command: sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max 2>/dev/null || echo '(conntrack module not loaded)'
